app_fee.value: International graduate applicants pay a nonrefundable $75 USD application fee ($50 USD for domestic applicants).

fee_waiver.value: University graduate admissions pages do not state any application fee waiver policy for international applicants (and Civil and Architectural Engineering states it cannot waive the fee).

gre_general.value: University graduate policy requires GRE General scores (school code 6822, within 5 years) unless waived by the program; all Frank H. Dotterweich College of Engineering Ph.D. programs do not require the GRE (overridden at the program level).
gre_general.quote: Students applying for other graduate programs must submit the Graduate Record Exam (GRE; Code#6822)

also.quote: Have an official Graduate Record Examination score or other program specific entrance exam taken within the last five years.

toefl_min.value: University minimum is 4 on the new TOEFL iBT scale for tests taken after January 21, 2026 (or 79 on the traditional iBT / 550 paper-based scale).
toefl_min.quote: A score of 79 (internet-based) or a 4 or higher on test taken past January 21, 2026 is the university minimum requirement for all graduate students.

also.quote: a minimum TOEFL score of 550 (paper-based), 213 (computer-based), or 79 (internet-based).

ielts_min.value: University minimum is IELTS 6.0 overall band score, submitted electronically by the IELTS test center.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum score required is a 6.0 overall band score. Texas A&M University-Kingsville only accepts scores submitted electronically by the IELTS test center.

english_waiver.value: India is not on TAMUK's list of exempt English-speaking countries; Indian applicants need TOEFL (79 / 4), IELTS (6.0), PTE (53), Duolingo (100), GRE Verbal >= 146, at least 12 graded U.S./exempt-country credits (C or better), or TAMUK ELTC / TIEC TIEP completion.
english_waiver.quote: All international students are required to take one of the above english proficiency tests unless they qualify for a waiver. | Students who have completed their entire formal education at the secondary or postsecondary level in the following countries are exempt from the TOEFL requirement: | Based on the review and decision of the College of Graduate Studies, students who have earned at least 12 credits, with a grade C or better, in university-level courses from a U.S. institution or an institution in one of the countries listed above, may be exempt from TOEFL.

notes: Public R2 university in Kingsville, Texas (Texas A&M University System). Offers 3 STEM Ph.D. degrees represented by 6 Atlas records: Engineering, Ph.D. (Chemical, Civil, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering specializations; Sustainable Energy Engineering specialization has no separate Atlas field), Environmental Engineering, Ph.D. (including the Environmental Sustainability and Resilience track), and Wildlife and Rangeland Science, Ph.D. (mapped to biology with also_fields=['environment']). Excludes Horticulture, Cooperative Ph.D. (degree awarded by and applied through Texas A&M University), Hispanic Studies Cooperative Ph.D., and Ed.D. programs.
